jobPostingInfo.title: Electronics Integration Engineer
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Company

ALPINE RACING LIMITED

Job Description

The Role 

The role of our Mechanical Design Engineer - Electrical Systems Integration:

The main responsibilities are the 3D Mechanical Design and integration of all Electrical components on and off car in accordance with the F1 technical regulations.  The role involves the 3D design of composites and metallic parts alongside the design and routing of complex wiring harnesses. You will also be using CAD data to produce components and harnesses’ mechanical drawings and associated documentation to ensure the electrical components and assemblies are installed as per design intent.  Additional activities will include working on future car programmes along with the implementation of development technologies. 

 

Who We're Looking For 

We're seeking an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer with a passion for high-performance engineering and a desire to solve complex technical challenges. 

Experience in Formula One or elite motorsport is desirable, but we're equally interested in engineers from other demanding engineering sectors where precision, innovation and performance are critical. 

You will ideally have: 

  • Degree qualification (or equivalent) in Mechanical Engineering. 
  • Strong understanding of engineering first principles. 
  • Proven experience in mechanical design and product integration. 
  • Advanced CAD skills, ideally using CATIA V5 or 3DEXPERIENCE (experience with NX or equivalent systems is also welcomed). 
  • Experience designing metallic and composite components. 
  • The ability to manage complex packaging and integration challenges. 
  • A creative and analytical approach to problem-solving. 
  • Confidence working both independently and within multidisciplinary engineering teams. 

Experience with electrical systems, motorsport harness design, military-spec connectors or electrical integration would be advantageous, but exceptional mechanical design capability is our primary focus. 

 

Why Alpine F1 Team? 

At Alpine F1 Team, your work won't sit on a shelf. It will become part of a Formula One car competing on the world stage. 

You'll work alongside some of the industry's brightest engineers in a fast-paced environment where innovation is encouraged, decisions happen quickly and your ideas can make a genuine impact on performance. 

In return, we offer: 

  • The opportunity to influence race-winning Formula One technology. 
  • State-of-the-art facilities at Enstone. 
  • Competitive remuneration package. 
  • Private medical healthcare. 
  • Free on-site gym. 
  • Subsidised restaurant. 
  • Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities. 
  • A collaborative and inclusive culture where engineering excellence thrives. 

If you're motivated by technical challenge, passionate about mechanical design and excited by the prospect of seeing your work compete at the pinnacle of motorsport, we'd love to hear from you.
